mission.label: Why ELA
mission.p1: Most apps make you tap words. ELA makes you speak, write and pass real exams. Every academy follows an official framework — CEFR for European languages, HSK for Mandarin — with teachers who track your progress every week.
mission.p2: You learn with structured video lessons, weekly live classes, a Learning Assistant available day and night, and a verified certificate that proves your level to embassies, universities and employers.
mission.li.1: Certified teachers and small live classes
mission.li.2: Official exam preparation: Goethe, HSK, IELTS, TORFL
mission.li.3: Learning Assistant for practice between lessons
mission.li.4: Verifiable certificates for visas and jobs
steps.label: How it works
steps.title: Three steps to your first lesson.
steps.1.title: Create your account
steps.1.desc: Choose your interface language, then the language you want to learn. Your first full lesson is free.
steps.2.title: Follow your path
steps.2.desc: Structured levels from A1, weekly live classes, quizzes and a Learning Assistant that corrects you.
steps.3.title: Pass your exam
steps.3.desc: Prepare the Goethe, HSK, IELTS or TORFL with mock exams — and earn your verified ELA certificate.
